_comment: TDM few-step distillation (chroma/train_tdm.py) with role-based LoRA: one frozen 8.9B base + a student adapter (standard lora_A/lora_B keys) + a fake-score adapter (lora_A_fake/lora_B_fake). Data-free w.r.t. images — the parquet dataset supplies captions (and preview ground truth). The student is a tdm_steps-step CFG-free sampler; the saved tdm_student_*.safetensors loads directly into inference.py --lora with --steps 4 and guidance 0. Works for every parallelism (override with --parallelism/--devices).
_comment_resume: Resumed after the disk-full crash: training reached step ~1400 but the last surviving checkpoint is step 950 (later saves failed on the full disk).
_comment_grad_ckpt: MUST stay true at this batch: RamTorch stage workers run forwards on their own threads where the driver's (thread-local) no_grad does not apply, so even infer() builds graphs and keeps activations alive — per-block checkpointing collapses that footprint (krea2 2026-08-18 probes).
_comment_batch: 4x8=32 in-flight samples at 1024px (4096 img tokens/sample — 4x the 512px cost, so this matches ~128 in-flight 512px samples; krea2's 512px probes peaked ~40 GB at 96). The embed chunk is grad-checkpointed, so the driver premium stays modest.
_comment_lr: Demo recipe: fake-score LR ~5x the student LR, betas (0, 0.95), clip 1.0 on both. HALVED from 2e-5/1e-4 for the A/B vs the -legacy run: at full LR both modes showed periodic loss spikes and grainy 4-step convergence (decoupled mode collapsed outright), pointing at LR-driven instability.
_comment_tdm: tdm_steps = K (student sampling steps). tdm_cfg = teacher guidance baked into the student — NOTE this is external CFG against the empty prompt; the model's own guidance input stays 0 (Chroma1 convention). tdm_separate_intervals keeps each segment's diffused tau range non-overlapping (paper default); tdm_randmid is the demo's optional mid-point regularizer. tdm_huber enables the Pseudo-Huber surrogate objective for the student update.
_comment_decoupled: Decoupled DMD (arXiv:2511.22677): the DMD target splits as DM + (tdm_cfg-1)*CA with DM = x0_real - x0_fake (regularizer) and CA = x0_real - x0_unc (engine). tdm_ca_ratio = lam replaces the legacy sum with a normalized mix where CA carries exactly lam of the step's mean-abs magnitude and DM the rest (magnitude anchored to the legacy delta, so lr/loss scales transfer). null = legacy math. tdm_dm_floor = gamma floors DM's normalizer at gamma*mean|CA| so a near-zero DM fades out instead of being amplified to unit scale.
_comment_ratio: !! WARNING (2026-08-21): DO NOT USE the ratio rescale for now — keep tdm_ca_ratio null (legacy math). The 1024px r128 run in ratio mode (lam=0.667, floor 0.25) collapsed by step ~250: loss_d exploded to 3-36 while previews degenerated. Legacy delta at cfg 3 is DM + 2*CA. See memory/worklog.md 2026-08-21.
_comment_teacher: Teacher = Chroma1-HD base weights (bf16, native flow keys).
_comment_data: TDM only consumes captions; images are decoded solely for preview ground truth, so worker count is modest.
